title: diag.4: radio — TCXO ready verification
description: After SetStandby(STDBY_XOSC), read SX1262 GetStatus. If mode bits don't show STANDBY_XOSC within 10ms, retry with increasing delay (10/20/50/100ms). Adapt: record the actual warm-up time and use it for all subsequent standby transitions. Report DIAG_RADIO_TCXO_ADAPT with the measured delay. Never fail — just wait longer.
close_reason: TCXO ready verification with warm-up adaptation landed (diag.4, spec 02a 2a.10.5 family): lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/tcxo_warmup.c + include/lichen/tcxo_warmup.h — freestanding module with an injected status_fn (platform reads SX1262 GetStatus mode bits) and injected sleep_fn. Semantics per the bead: polls immediately, then after increasing delays 10/20/50/100 ms; on ready, records the measured warm-up (monotonic max) and adapts — subsequent transitions wait the recorded time up-front; on_adapt callback fires when the recorded delay changes; never fails — when still not ready after all retries, records the cumulative 180 ms elapsed so subsequent transitions wait at least that long. Tests (standalone gcc harness): immediate-ready (no sleeps), ready-at-retry-1 (adapt to 10), ready-at-all-retries (adapt to 100), never-ready (adapt to cumulative 180, wait returns false), retry delay order 10/20/50/100. CMake updated to compile tcxo_warmup.c in the diag Zephyr library. During development I self-caught and fixed: probe_status ready_at=-1 sentinel bug (0 >= -1 always true), probe_sleep no-op not recording, and the module missing warm-up recording on never-ready — the 'wait longer' adaptation is the bead's core requirement and is now correctly implemented. cppcheck gate exit 0 (stddef include added for NULL). This module is consumed by the SX1262 standby transition path when hw wiring lands.
